title: 定制不盲选！AD7 TailorX硬核配置&服务指南
publisher: XDS喜德盛 brand-named account on XHS
notes: Brand-named post about the 2026 AD7 TailorX custom-paint program, shown as posted one day before access (no absolute date displayed). It lists a T700+T800 aero-tube frame, Shimano 105 Di2, BRANTA C45 SL wheels, sizes XS–XL, nine iridescent and eleven two-tone paint choices, and an approximately 4–8 week build after order confirmation, subject to production scheduling; custom orders cannot be returned or exchanged. Two finish diagrams are labelled AD7 2026 TailorX. No price, complete weight, geometry, maximum tire clearance, stiffness test or warranty term is given, and the publishing account was not independently verified as the corporate account.
